A neighbourhood institution

North Haven Barber Shop is the kind of place Calgary grew up with: experienced barbers, honest work, and a chair that always feels like yours. For more than two decades the shop has served North Haven and the surrounding NW communities — fathers, sons, and everyone who wants a cut done right the first time.

No rushed chairs and no guesswork. Tell us how you like it, or ask what's going to suit you — we'll sort it out, finish it clean, and get you back out the door looking sharp.
